text: Hi Achi! We are 2 adults staying in Mirissa (Aura by Epic Collection, Yatipila Road). We would like a private full-day Sinharaja wildlife tour (snakes, lizards, frogs, monkeys, birds) on 16 March 2027, with pickup from our hotel around 5:00. What is the total price including entrance, guide and transport from Mirissa? We pay in cash on the day. If it rains, can we move to 22 March? Thank you!

Hello! We are 2 adults staying at Aura by Epic Collection, Mirissa (Yatipila Road). We would like the sunset lagoon catamaran safari on 15 March. Is pickup from our hotel included? What is the price for 2 people? We pay on the day. Thank you!

Hello! 2 adults from Mirissa. We would like the sunrise crocodile river safari on 20 March. What is the price for 2, what time and where is the meeting point? Do you offer transport from Mirissa? Do you keep any crocodile in an enclosure? We only want to see wild animals. Thank you!

Нужна машина с водителем на весь день: Мирисса (Aura by Epic Collection) → Удавалаве → Мирисса, Чт 18 марта, 2 взрослых, выезд 8:30, ожидание до ~18:30 (сафари + Elephant Transit Home). Предложите цену. Оплата наличными по факту.
Hello! Can we book 2 massages (strong, deep tissue, no oil) on 17 March in the afternoon? What times are available and what is the price? Thank you!

Hello! We are 2 adults from Mirissa. We would like to visit Snake Farm Weligama (Traditional Farm) on 22 March 2027, in the morning. Is it open then? What is the price per person and how long is the visit? We would like to hold non-venomous snakes only. Thank you!

Нужна машина с водителем на весь день, Пт 19 марта: Мирисса → Ахангама (Animal SOS, 10:30) → Коггала → Галле → Унаватуна (ужин до 21:30) → Мирисса. 2 взрослых. Выезд ~9:30. Сколько стоит? Водитель ждёт на каждой остановке. Оплата наличными в конце.
Hello! We are 2 adults staying in Mirissa. Do you still offer the sunset boat trip with dinner? We would like it on 23 March 2027. What time does it start and what is the price per person? Thank you!

Нужна машина с водителем в Сб 20 марта: выезд из отеля в (время уточню после ответа оператора) в Матару (Nilwala crocodile safari), ожидание 2–3 часа, обратно в отель. 2 взрослых. Сколько стоит? Оплата по факту.
